changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Enable pg_trgm extension for ILIKE/like index support on text (e.g. display_name search). Requires DB superuser or extension already present.
changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: GIN trigram index on display_name to speed up ILIKE '%value%' searches (e.g. self-advisor lead search by name)
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_n_person_display_name_gin_trgm ON n_person USING gin (display_name gin_trgm_ops)
